Review of @FTMarketslive 👇  

- 1 x $200K 2 Step Plus account

- Score: 7.5/10

- Overall, i found the general trading rules okay to deal with. The shield risk protocol rule is restrictive but I can see how it works well in preventing full porting and overleveraging (basically floating equity cannot hit -1% at any time, otherwise profit split is permanently reduced). No consistency rule on this account is also a bonus. Equity-based drawdown is not ideal for swing traders but due to the shield risk protocol I don't get near the daily drawdown limit anyway. Generally, the rules work well.

- There were some issues I found though. 
❗️They have a rule which means that you can't hold a partially closed position overnight. I partially closed a position once price had reached a key level as part of effective risk management, I then resized the position back to full when price had pulled back some more, same day. Even though the position was back at full size by the close, they said that still counts as a partial close and deducted the profit from my payout. Not a big deal but a bit annoying.

❗️For the next payout, price again had reached a key level and I wanted to manage risk. Didnt partially close this time. Instead, took a short against the long trade in profit to go net neutral. Turns out holding a short against a long position on the same asset is also not allowed and again, the profit was deducted from my payout.

- Effectively, this means they have rules that punish you for trading safer & with more risk management. Its not a massive deal given they don't breach your account for it, but i do think those rules could be written better.

❗️One more little thing is 5 days with a minimum of 0.5% profit each day essentially forces me to continue trading when I'd rather not and bank the payout. Again, not a big deal but it would be better if it were less days like 3, not 5, or 0.25%, not 0.5% imo.

🟢 When it came to processing the payouts, well, I dont think there is any other prop firm that I have tried that's processed payouts as quickly as they do. For a relatively newer prop, thats quite impressive.

🟢 When i emailed them asking about their rules, they replied very quickly. This is good support.

All in all, this is a good prop firm that I would recommend to others. They have a good balance of rules. If some of those rules i mentioned earlier were written a bit better, the score would be 9/10 not 7.5. 

Next one comes tomorrow
